claims.statement: Current PZU home-insurance terms define covered flooding to include water escaping because of installation failure and other specified causes.
PZU provides home assistance and publishes specific documentation paths for water-damage claims.

contrary_evidence: A sensor alert does not establish policy coverage, causation, damage value or insurer acceptance.

structure.control_point: The signed event timeline joining sensor evidence, mitigation, repair and insurer closure
structure.critical_dependency: Insurer acceptance of sensor evidence and a reliable installer or plumber response network

thesis: Embed with housing managers, insurers and plumber networks to turn a leak sensor alert into a consented evidence timeline: detected water, shutoff or mitigation, plumber diagnosis, repair completion and damage documentation. The paid event is an insurer-accepted claim, assistance close or documented avoided escalation—not sensor monitoring. Verified claim and repair outcomes create installation-specific loss and response models that improve triage and insurer pricing.
title: Sensor-to-Water-Claim Settlement
uncertainties: Insurer willingness to pay for verified closes
